site.sitedescription: Meadow located in the Nelder Grove of the Sierra National Forest. Surrounding vegetation: Overstory species of incense cedar, white fir, ponderosa pine, sugar pine, and black oak are found with deer brush, currant, bear berry, and rose as the understory. Meadow plants (grasses, sedges, corn-lily, various herbs) are also found.
